description: Implement all hardware controllers exactly matching legacy firmware behavior. Each controller must use correct pins, timing, and protocols.

userStories.title: Implement HardwareConfig.h with pin definitions
userStories.description: Define all pin constants matching legacy firmware exactly.
acceptanceCriteria: All pin definitions match legacy brevitest-firmware.h lines 175-191
Use hal_pin_t and uint16_t types where legacy does
Include all timing constants from legacy header
userStories.notes: Implemented in supabase-firmware/src/HardwareConfig.h. All pins, timing constants, thermistor lookup table defined. NOTE: Pins D22, D23, D26, A6 require hardware mapping for Boron compatibility.

userStories.title: Implement MotorController wake_motor() and sleep_motor()
acceptanceCriteria: sleep_motor() sets pinMotorSleep LOW, sets motor_awake = false
wake_motor() sets pinMotorSleep HIGH, delays 10000us, sets motor_awake = true
userStories.notes: Implemented as MotorController::enable()/disable() calling HAL::motorWake()/motorSleep(). State tracked in HAL._motorAwake.

userStories.title: Implement MotorController move_one_eighth_step()
userStories.description: Implement single step movement with limit detection.
acceptanceCriteria: Check stage limit switch (pinStageLimit) for proximal movement
Double-check with 10000us delay if limit triggered
Reset stage_position and microns_error to 0 at limit
Step HIGH then LOW with step_delay microseconds each
Return false if at limit, true if step completed
userStories.notes: Implemented as MotorController::executeStep() with limit check, 10000us debounce, position reset at limit.

userStories.title: Implement MotorController move_stage()
acceptanceCriteria: Wake motor if not already awake
Calculate direction from sign of microns parameter
Set pinMotorDir HIGH for proximal (negative), LOW for distal (positive)
Track microns_error as remainder for next move
userStories.notes: Implemented as MotorController::moveRelative() with direction calculation, _positionError tracking, step delay clamping.

userStories.title: Implement MotorController reset_stage()
userStories.description: Implement stage homing to proximal limit.
acceptanceCriteria: Sleep motor if sleep parameter is true
userStories.notes: Implemented as MotorController::home(sleepAfter) with moveUntilLimit(), initial position move.

userStories.title: Implement MotorController position functions
userStories.description: Implement move_stage_to_position and specific position functions.
acceptanceCriteria: move_stage_to_position() calculates distance from current and calls move_stage()
userStories.notes: Implemented: moveToPosition(), moveToTestStart(), moveToOpticalRead(), moveToMagnetometer(). Position constants in StagePosition namespace.

userStories.title: Implement MotorController oscillate_stage()
acceptanceCriteria: Takes amplitude (microns), step_delay, cycles, inBCODE parameters
Loops cycles times: move +amplitude, BCODE_loop() if inBCODE, move -amplitude, BCODE_loop() if inBCODE
Returns early if test_state becomes CANCELLED
userStories.notes: Implemented as MotorController::oscillate() with Particle.process() calls for BCODE processing, _cancelled flag checking.

userStories.title: Implement HeaterController temperature reading
userStories.description: Implement thermistor reading with lookup table.
acceptanceCriteria: Use raw_table_lookup() with legacy temperature table
Temperature table: 21 entries from 0-1000C (10x scale) mapped to ADC values
Interpolate between table entries for accuracy
Store temperature in temp_C_10X (10x actual for decimal precision)
userStories.notes: Implemented in HeaterController::readTemperature() using HAL::readThermistorRaw() and HAL::rawToTemperature() with THERMISTOR_TEMP_TABLE/THERMISTOR_RAW_TABLE lookup.

userStories.title: Implement HeaterController turn_on/off_heater()
acceptanceCriteria: turn_off_heater() writes 0 to heater pin, delays 5000us, sets heater_on=false, power=0
Checks temp_C_10X > HEATER_MAX_TEMPERATURE (600) and turns off if exceeded
userStories.notes: Implemented in HeaterController::applyPower() and HAL::setHeaterPower()/setHeaterOff(). Max temp check in checkSafetyConditions().

userStories.title: Implement HeaterController PID controller
acceptanceCriteria: Calculate proportional term: error * k_p_num / k_p_den
Calculate integral term: accumulated error * k_i_num / k_i_den
Calculate derivative term: (error - previous_error) * k_d_num / k_d_den
userStories.notes: Implemented in HeaterController::calculatePID() with numerator/denominator format matching legacy. Anti-windup integral clamping included.

userStories.title: Implement LaserController enable/disable functions
acceptanceCriteria: Sets digital pin HIGH to enable
Track power_on state for each laser
userStories.legacyReference: Derived from pin definitions and usage patterns
userStories.notes: Implemented in LaserController with enableLaser()/disableLaser()/disableAllLasers(). State tracked in _enabled[] array. Safety interlock included.

userStories.title: Implement LaserController turn_on_laser_for_duration()
acceptanceCriteria: turn_on_laser_for_duration(channel, duration) enables laser, delays, disables
Used for LED testing in setup() with 250ms duration
userStories.notes: Implemented as LaserController::pulse() with configurable timing. Uses setPulseMode() for duration configuration.

userStories.title: Implement BarcodeScanner scan_barcode()
acceptanceCriteria: Set pinBarcodeTrigger LOW to start scan
Wait for pinBarcodeReady HIGH or timeout (BARCODE_READ_TIMEOUT=1000ms)
Read characters from Serial1 into buffer
Set pinBarcodeTrigger HIGH to stop scan
Return barcode type based on length: 36=CARTRIDGE, 32=MAGNETOMETER, 16=STRESS_TEST
userStories.notes: Implemented in BarcodeScanner::triggerScan() with full protocol, retry logic, and type detection via getBarcodeType().

userStories.title: Implement BuzzerController basic functions
userStories.notes: Implemented in BuzzerController namespace with playTone(), cartridgeInsert(), cartridgeRemove(), standardBeep(). All constants match legacy.

userStories.title: Implement BuzzerController alert patterns
userStories.description: Implement repeating buzzer patterns for alerts.
acceptanceCriteria: turn_on_buzzer_alert() starts periodic alert at BUZZER_ALERT_PERIOD (4000ms)
turn_on_buzzer_problem() starts periodic problem at BUZZER_PROBLEM_PERIOD (777ms)
Uses Timer for non-blocking periodic operation
userStories.notes: Implemented with startPeriodicAlert(AlertType) using Particle Timer for non-blocking operation. stopPeriodicAlert() cleans up.

userStories.title: Implement LEDController indicator functions
acceptanceCriteria: Use Particle LEDStatus API for indicators
userStories.notes: Implemented in LEDController with LEDStatus objects matching legacy exactly. showPrompt() activates indicators.

userStories.title: Implement Spectrophotometer I2C switch control
userStories.description: Implement PCA9536 switch for 3-channel spectrophotometer selection.
acceptanceCriteria: Uses Wire library for I2C communication
userStories.notes: Implemented via HAL::initSpectroMux() and HAL::selectSpectroChannel(). Constants in HardwareConfig.h.

userStories.title: Implement AS7341 spectrophotometer driver
acceptanceCriteria: Read all 10 spectral channels: F1-F8, Clear, NIR
userStories.notes: Implemented in drivers/AS7341.cpp with full channel reading, configuration, SMUX management. Spectrophotometer class wraps driver.

userStories.title: Implement Spectrophotometer continuous scanning
userStories.description: Implement continuous spectrophotometer reading during stage movement.
acceptanceCriteria: spectrophotometer_reading_continuous(baseline, scans, log) takes readings while moving
Calculate step_delay based on integration time
Track reading number, channel, position, temperature, timestamp
userStories.notes: Implemented as Spectrophotometer::readingContinuous() with motor coordination. Calculates segment sizes, coordinates F1-F4/F5-F8 measurements with stage movement.

userStories.title: Document all hardware timing requirements
userStories.notes: Created supabase-firmware/docs/HARDWARE_TIMING.md with comprehensive timing documentation for all subsystems.

codebasePatterns: Use delayMicroseconds() for precise timing, delay() for longer waits
Always check limit switches before motor movement
Track hardware state (awake, on, etc.) to avoid unnecessary operations
Use volatile for variables accessed from interrupts
knownIssues: HardwareConfig.h defines pins D22, D23, D26, A6 which don't exist on Particle Boron. These need remapping for hardware compatibility.
